why_this_email: Week 6's lab runs 009, 012, 013, 014, 015, 016, 020, 021, 022, 023 and 024, so none of those may appear in the walkthrough. 034 carries a prompt injection in a placement the lab never shows: a line inside a fabricated quoted thread, attributed to the IT help desk, saying an automated triage tool has cleared it. Its sender is known bad at address level, which is the one condition that lets the week 6 fact check reach a real email.
